description:
Turn speech into useful text.

Utterform is a lightweight desktop voice-to-text utility. Record a short voice clip, transcribe it with OpenAI GPT Transcribe or local Whisper, optionally transform the text with a built-in or rewritten prompt, and send the result to the clipboard, a TXT/Markdown file, the focused window, or a combination of those. A reserved key combination starts and finishes a recording without raising the window.
Switch the microphone from the tray. The headset for calls is plugged in, but you
want to talk to the laptop. Right-click the Utterform icon, open Microphone and pick
the laptop's microphone. The next dictation uses it, and it stays chosen until you
pick another one. System default follows the microphone your system uses and names
it. It is the same setting as Settings → Recording → Microphone.
A chosen microphone that is unplugged stays in the menu, greyed out, and recordings
fall back to the system default until it is back.
Everything from 1.0: a first-run assistant, Settings with search and no Save button,
text actions on your ChatGPT subscription (experimental), the Context action for the
selected text or the clipboard, an action per application and transcription of
voice messages and audio files.
